flowchart-direction-line.comment: The direction line, From the current position, try TB, BT, RL, LR, TD in that order, taking the last direction for the selected family. flowchart-name-entity.comment: Give an entity the surrounding name scope, keeping internal directives independent. common.md#entities: A directive right after the `#` or right before the `;` lies inside the entity, which is read in the text without its directives, and so do two directives right before the `;`.
flowchart-name-entity.name: variable.mermaid

flowchart-heading-title.comment: Read the optional subgraph title between label delimiters. flowchart.md#subgraphs: A `space` before `[` is a `name-piece` of the grammar, though not part of the value of the name (see [FlowchartSubgraphStatement](../ast/flowchart.md#flowchartsubgraphstatement)), and nothing may follow the closing `]` but the separator: `subgraph S [t]` is accepted, and `subgraph S[t]` followed by a space and a line break is rejected.

patterns.comment: Each entity is read as its placeholder (). flowchart.md#lexical-structure: This section describes the diagram's own unit rules, item 4 of [Reading a source](../common.md#reading-a-source).
